Commissioner Nikowitz called for a recess at 6- 30 p. m. and reconvened at
6: 59 p. m.

Commissioner Brewster reported on the Travel Club presentation from Premier
Travel Agency.

Commissioner Beebe expressed his concerns involving the mobile park homes
and the increases in the rent for spaces. He also commended the positive
involvement of the San Dimas City Council and City Manager, Chris Constantin,
in regards to the problems occurring at Charter Oiak Mobile Park.

Chairperson KarasIk- McGee shared that she has contact information for Pomona
Valley Transportation that could do workshops or seminars for seniors,

Vice Chairperson Martinez commentated on the upcoming increases in health
insurance  and Medicare.
